families.title: the geometry of a middle-density level surface
families.scientific_target: the geometry of a middle-density level surface
families.finding_goal: Characterize the geometry of a middle-density level surface

questions.o1_f1: In the supplied Rayleigh–Taylor instability snapshot, consider the complete supplied three-dimensional mesh. Investigate the geometry of a middle-density level surface.
